answer.prompt:
Image 1 is the room to edit. Images 2–7 are each one product to add. Keep image 1 exactly as it is: same framing and camera, ceiling, walls, curtains, floor, fireplace and logs, and the same light. Add nothing else. Placement: the fireplace is on the right-hand wall.
- Image 4 (rug): flat on the floor in front of the fireplace. It runs from just below the curtain hems to the fireplace hearth and spans about half the image width.
- Image 2 (sofa): mid-room on the rug, about level with the curtain hems. It is centered on the fireplace and seen side-on, facing right toward the fireplace. It is about a quarter of the image width.
- Image 3 (two armchairs): both stand between the sofa and the mantel. One is just left of the fireplace, in front of the plain wall near the room corner, facing the other. The other is just in front of the fireplace's right side, facing back toward the first. Each is about an eighth of the image width.
- Image 5 (coffee table): on the rug, centered between the sofa and the fireplace.
- Image 6 (mirror): hung centered on the chimney breast above the mantel, about a seventh of the image width.
- Image 7 (floor lamp): beside the left armchair, near the room corner.
The floor near the camera, at the bottom left, stays empty.
Copy each product's design exactly: shape, proportions, colors, materials and details. The product photos are studio catalog shots, many of them renders, and give the design only. Each product must look photographed in this room by this camera: soft daylight from the left windows with shaded right sides, and this image's white balance, contrast, grain and sharpness. Add contact shadows on the floor and real creases and wear on fabric and wood. Make it a photograph, not a render.

placements.where: mid-room on rug, side-on facing fireplace
